narr: An MCS moved across Central Alabama during the morning hours on Friday, March 18th. The leading edge of the MCS produced very heavy rainfall, and resulted in flash flooding across portions of Shelby County.
ev: The Pelham Police Department reported stalled out and flooded vehicles near the intersection of Highway 31 and Amphitheater Road. Several streets flooded and impassable in the same area.
lsr: PELHAM PD REPORTING CARS ARE STALLING DUE TO FLOODING ON AMPHITHEATER RD & HWY 31. IN ADDITION, SEVERAL STREETS ARE ALSO UNDER WATER.
